websiteHub.title: Choose the model that fits.
websiteHub.intro: One-time development or Website as a Service - you decide how to start.

oneTime.title: Websites with a fixed starting price.
oneTime.intro: A one-time investment to design and build your website.
oneTime.note: All prices exclude 21% VAT. The final price depends on scope, features, and selected services. You always receive a clear quote in advance.

waas.title: Three packages, one fixed monthly fee.
waas.intro: Website, hosting, and maintenance in one subscription. Choose Start, Business, or Premium.
waas.note: Prices are per month and exclude 21% VAT. A 12-month term gives you the best rate; flexible monthly costs €15 per month more. Add-ons and exact scope are set out in your quote. Website as a Service has specific terms on ownership, transfer, and termination. See our Terms & Conditions for details.

hosting.title: Annual hosting without the admin.
hosting.intro: Fast, secure hosting with SSL, backups, and personal support.
hosting.note: Prices are annual amounts on a 12-month term and exclude 21% VAT. You always receive a clear proposal in advance.

maintenance.title: Ongoing maintenance on a clear monthly plan.
maintenance.intro: Updates, monitoring, and support - handled for you.
maintenance.note: Prices are per month and exclude 21% VAT. A 12-month term gives you the best rate; the monthly plan stays flexible under the terms.

termsInfo.title: Good to know
items: One-time websites are a one-time investment; Website as a Service is a monthly subscription.
Recurring services are available flexible monthly or on a 12-month term.
For Website as a Service, flexible monthly costs €15 per month more than the 12-month rate.
The basic online booking system is included with Business and Premium; with Start it is an add-on.
Hosting is billed annually on a 12-month term; maintenance according to the selected contract.
Subscriptions on a 12-month term can be cancelled afterwards according to the terms.
The final price depends on scope, features, and selected services. You always receive a clear quote in advance.
After delivery, you receive a full walkthrough of your website.
